title: 4H Private Classic Car Tour Miami by Request Only
includes: All taxes, fees and handling charges
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
May be operated by a multi-lingual guide
A maximum of 5 people per booking
Children must be accompanied by an adult
Operates in hot weather conditions, please dress appropriately
Subject to favorable weather conditions. If canceled due to poor weather, you will be given the option of an alternative date or full refund in certain cases
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This fabulous Classic car tour will visits the Art Deco Historic District with colorful buildings with a century-old history. 

Explore Ocean Dr, Collins Ave, Millionaire's Row and many more Landmarks...

Crossing Biscayne Bay via Julia Tuttle causeway, you will cruise through the Design District, Wynwood, Downtown Miami, Bayside, also visits the Bohemian neighborhood of Coconut Grove, cruise through the beautiful city of Coral Gables, with the Biltmore Hotel, Venetian Pool and more. To finish, take a break at Little Havana, and grab a Cafecito. Then, head back to Miami Beach via Mac Arthur causeway or the Venetian way (depending traffic)

IMPORTANT: FOR TOUR BOOKINGS WITHIN 72 HOURS PLEASE CALL US 

PLEASE, MENTION IN YOUR ORDER, WHAT DEPARTURE TIME YOU ARE LOOKING FOR.
